verdict.rationale: Elicit documents Research Reports that summarize the relevant papers at the end of the Systematic Review workflow, and the API can also generate automated reports. Reports export as PDF or Word, tables export as CSV or Excel, and collaborators can share and edit document and table artifacts, so the report can reach stakeholders. Missing for 10: documentation of the report's internal section structure, and independent or hands-on evidence of report quality and layout (community comments cover summary accuracy, not report structure).
